CASE STUDIES · PROJECT SCENARIOS

See how a clear brief becomes a launch plan.

These pages explain the decisions, files and checkpoints used in OEM/ODM projects. Customer names, sales figures and performance claims are published only with written permission and supporting evidence.

Skincare launch system

Need: a focused brightening and barrier routine for an e-commerce launch.

Work: select a hero serum, companion cream and two-piece set; align claim language, texture, pack and content sequence for the target market.

Deliverables: brief, formula direction, sample notes, packaging route, artwork checklist and replenishment review.

2hero formats
1set route
6approval gates
90day review

Haircare range extension

Need: extend a shampoo offer into masks, oils and scalp care without confusing the customer.

Work: map each product to a routine role, separate rinse-off and leave-on claims, then create a launch order based on channel demand.

Deliverables: range architecture, formula shortlist, pack family, usage education and sales feedback loop.

4routine roles
3pack families
1content map
1replenishment plan
